events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Thompson (DET) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Towns (NYK) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and Detroit is given possession when play resumes.
Stewart (DET) hands the ball off and absorbs the contact with Anunoby (NYK) as he sets the screen.
Towns (NYK) moves laterally into Cunningham (DET), initiating body contact that affects the driving shot attempt.
Beasley (DET) legally contests Bridges' (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Bridges (NYK) legally contests Cunningham's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Towns (NYK) sets the screen on Thompson (DET) and does not give him room to avoid the contact.
Hardaway Jr. (DET) establishes himself in a screening position in Bridges' (NYK) path and does not deliver contact.
Hart (NYK) legally contests Beasley's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Stewart (DET) jumps vertically to contest Brunson's (NYK) driving shot attempt. Brunson places his off-arm against Stewart's body and initiates the incidental contact prior to falling to the floor.
Cunningham (DET) places his off-arm against Brunson (NYK) and releases from contact.
Towns (NYK) legally contests Beasley's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Harris (DET) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
